text_block_list.text:
Still worried about Маяно Топ Ган's
low spirits
a few months after her debut,
I bring her to a
racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When we arrive, she explains that the
races she's
run in are much more boring
than she had
imagined.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To help with her dissatisfaction, I decide
to have
her run in races that will allow
her natural skills to
shine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
